_about: The I-601 cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The address (uscis.gov/i-601-addresses, updated 10/23/2025; with an I-212 in the same envelope, the I-212 page's row, updated 11/07/2025), the subject and the fees ($1,050 for the I-601, $1,175 for the I-212, and the $0 categories: Form G-1055 10/01/26) come from src/inadmissibility_waiver.py. The Form I-212 lines show only when it is in the packet. The attorney approves this file before volume use.
